item.description: The European Commission and the Fundació Mies van der Rohe have unveiled the seven finalists for the 2026 European Union Prize for Contemporary Architecture — Mies van der Rohe Award. item.title: Zumthor’s LACMA David Geffen Galleries to open in April
item.description: The Los Angeles County Museum of Art has announced that the museum’s high-profile David Geffen Galleries will open on April 19th, 2026. Designed by Peter Zumthor, with SOM as a collaborating architect, the building opened temporarily for a three-day preview in June 2025. Image credit: Iwan BaanA ribbon-cutting ceremony will take place on April 19th, followed by two weeks of priority member access to the galleries and events. item.title: Disenchanted London and Hawksmoor’s architecture of terror and magnificence
item.description: At the southern end, I take an elevator and find myself in Greenwich, surrounded by tourists. After the sepulchral silence of the Isle of Dogs, it’s a shock. I walk across a sort of piazza, under the tall masts of the clipper ship Cutty Sark. The last of the Hawksmoor churches is just around the corner.
